name: Lemon Project
source:
With the holiday break starting, it's time for you to get started on that summer project! Go out there, sell your lemonade; but be careful, because word on the street is that there's been rising crime around the city...

Lemon Project is a visual novel with light simulation elements. You play as the lemonade girl, who befriends the customers she meets and learns about a curiosity that is happening in the neighborhood. 

[edited from [url=http://routezero.itch.io/lemon-project]official page[/url]]
translation:
假期开始了，是时候着手完成你的暑期项目了！出门去卖柠檬水吧；不过要小心，因为街坊间传闻城里的犯罪活动正在增加……

《Lemon Project》是一部带有轻度模拟要素的视觉小说。你将扮演卖柠檬水的女孩，与遇到的顾客成为朋友，并了解社区里正在发生的一件奇怪事情。

[改编自[url=http://routezero.itch.io/lemon-project]官方网站页面[/url]]
